reason: We already have unit tests, end-to-end tests and CI, and nothing has slipped through badly enough to make me add another tool. Recording scenarios and triaging diffs sounds like more work than writing the missing test, especially when I'm finally starting a migration I've put off for a year and don't want new moving parts.
objection: Replaying recorded sessions on two versions usually means a pile of noise I have to mask and babysit, and I'd bet the first run on our app produces more false diffs than real ones. The one-cent invoice demo is a cherry-picked README example, not my codebase.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch a real difference on our own app during the migration, within an hour of setup, that our existing suite missed.
